title: Pager signal fidelity and region-aware failover playbooks
creator: Aisha Kumar
description: Problem: Over the last 3 quarters we see a steady stream of on-call noise caused by region failover churn, transient KV cache pressure during autoscaling, and cascading tokenization latency when requests hit cold KV caches. These alerts often fire during known capacity events (deploys/scale-ups) and during controlled failovers, increasing MTTR and eroding trust in SLO alerts. Goal: Reduce noisy pages by 60% for SLO/region-failover related alerts while keeping high-fidelity SLO breach detection. Deliverables: 1) signal-fidelity rules that suppress or group alerts during known maintenance/rollout windows and when automated circuit-breaker load-shedding is active; 2) region-aware alert thresholds and deduplication logic that correlate multi-region symptoms; 3) documented and executable on-call playbooks (playbook snippets for Console and PagerDuty) with embedded safe remediation steps (toggle circuit-breaker, enable degraded-routing, scale dedicated pools); 4) incident-response automation for specific low-risk remediations (cache warming job, temporary traffic steering) with explicit rollback/guardrails.
tasks: Audit current SLO alerts and create mapping of 1200 alert rules -> 45 rule families
Define correlation keys (trace_id, model_variant, region, host-pool) and implement dedupe layer in alert router
Add context-aware suppression: detect deploy/scale events from infra events stream and mark related alerts as INFO for 10 minutes
Create circuit-breaker health metric dashboards and expose 'circuit state' to alerting pipeline
Author 6 concise on-call playbooks (multi-region failover, circuit open, KV cache pressure, load-shed triggered, noisy downstream, routing fallback) and register them in Console
Build a guarded automation run for two safe remediations: incremental dedicated-pool scale and automated cache-prefill job
Instrument PagerDuty integration to add 'playbook link' and 'automated action' buttons to alerts
Run a 2-region canary rollout of the dedupe+suppression rules and collect signal metrics
acceptance_criteria: Pager calls attributable to multi-region SLO alarms reduced by >=60% over a 14-day window compared to baseline
False-positive SLO alerts (post-triage) reduced to <=5% of total SLO alerts
On-call runbooks linked from alerts and accessible in Console; runbook open rate on alerts >=75%
Automated safe-remediation actions executed with explicit success/failure audit logged and reversible by on-call
No customer-facing downtime attributable to automated remediation during canary rollout
rollout_plan: Week 0: audit + design; stake-holder review with PM and Console UX
Week 1: implement dedupe layer and basic suppression rules in staging; airflow job to tag deploy/scale windows
Week 2: enable circuit-state metric publication and build playbook drafts; integrate with PagerDuty test instance
Week 3: run internal chaos test (simulated region latency) and verify suppression triggers only for correlated signals
Week 4: canary: enable in eu-west-1 for non-critical customer traffic; monitor metrics and on-call feedback
Week 5: expand to na-east-1 and na-west-2; gather telemetry for 14 days
Week 6: full rollout, retro, and convert manual mitigations into optional automation where safe
comments: 2026-02-11 - Aisha: Kickoff complete. Collected initial dataset of alerts for Q4-2025 and Q1-2026. Noted 3 recurring patterns: deploy burst, KV cold-cache spikes, and regional network hiccups.
2026-02-18 - Tomás: Implemented initial dedupe prototype in staging. Using (trace_id, model_variant, region) as primary correlation key. Observed 22% reduction in pages for synthetic deploy test.
2026-02-25 - PM Leila Cheng: Requested stronger guardrail for any automated action—automation must require explicit on-call confirmation in first two regions.
2026-03-03 - Design (Maya): Playbooks reviewed. Recommended 'one-screen' format with 3-step triage + 2 safe actions + rollback. Updated templates attached to Confluence.
2026-03-08 - SRE review: Added circuit-breaker 'trial-open' state to metrics to prevent oscillation. Suggest adding 5-minute cooling window before automated scaling.
2026-03-11 - Tomás: Canary enabled in eu-west-1 for internal traffic. Early telemetry shows pages down 48% and mttr improved by 18%. No customer-facing incidents.
2026-03-12 - Aisha: Moving to In Progress. Next: instrument PagerDuty action buttons and schedule cross-team blameless CZ for rollout Week 4.
risk: Medium risk: automated remediations could cause unintended routing changes if correlation rules are too permissive. Mitigations: canary gating, manual confirmation for first two regions, detailed audit logs and fast rollback path.
